en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard divided into four images. The upper left shows a hilltop castle‑like villa with crenellated tower, flag, and long veranda, surrounded by terraced vineyards. The upper right depicts steep vineyard terraces with scattered houses and a small round tower or pavilion at the top of the hill. The lower left view shows a large, ornate timber‑frame hotel or sanatorium building with multiple gables and a tall spire, set on a vine‑covered hillside. The lower right image presents a half‑timbered house with a distinctive rounded corner tower and a courtyard with an old wooden well or press. The card edge has a scalloped border. No printed caption text is visible.
